# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 2,407 AI agent tools in 40 categories, including 323 MCP servers. Checked daily, 323 of 323 reachable, last checked 2026-11-09. Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

<!-- mcp-reach:start -->

## MCP server reachability

Checked daily, 323 of 323 reachable, last checked 2026-11-09.

Once a day, AgentScout requests each listed MCP server URL and, when it is a different link, its GitHub URL. The request is HEAD, then GET, with a 20-second timeout. If that fails on TLS or gets no response, it retries once with a browser user agent. A server counts as reachable when its stored label is OK or Reachable, blocks automated checks. OK is HTTP 200-399 or 405, and also 401, 403 or 429 when the GitHub URL succeeded or that URL is the only one checked. Reachable, blocks automated checks means those 401, 403 or 429 responses without a harder error. Any other checked result is not reachable. A server missing from the check file is not yet checked and is not counted. The last-checked time is the checked field, in America/Los_Angeles. The rows are on the MCP status page and in status.json.

- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): the same reachability rows, with HTTP result and history
- [status.json](https://agentscouthq.com/status.json): machine-readable rows for every listed MCP server
- [Best MCP servers by task](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/): ranked lists, with the same daily check

<!-- mcp-reach:end -->

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse). AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19
MCP Registry ID: com.agentscouthq/directory
MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-11-09 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 323 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages ($0, $15, $49, $99/wk) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages
- [feed.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 of the latest tools and agent news

Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance

- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-11-08 to 2026-11-09): 84

- [Novera](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/novera.html) (added 2026-11-09): Novera is an independent AI assistant from TRON-ABS for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android that runs local text models with a 32k context, plus key-free web search and local FLUX.2 Klein image and ACE-Step music trials, with an experimental WebGPU browser version.
- [Html2MP4](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/html2mp4.html) (added 2026-11-09): Html2MP4 converts HTML, CSS and GSAP animations or a text prompt into downloadable MP4 videos for launches, product showcases and social stories, with editable templates, brand kits, a website-to-video mode and an MCP server for agents; new accounts start with 3 free credits.
- [Seedance 2.5](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/seedance-2-5.html) (added 2026-11-09): Seedance 2.5 is a web studio for generating cinematic videos from text, images or multiple references with the Seedance 2.5 model and others, then continuing in built-in image, audio, editing and asset tools; monthly credit plans start at $29.90.
- [Lanesra AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/lanesra-ai.html) (added 2026-11-09): Lanesra AI is an analytics layer for AI search that tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini and other answer engines describe, rank and recommend your brand against named competitors, then suggests fixes for AEO, GEO and agent experience; plans from about €150 a month with a 3-day free trial.
- [YouTube Summarizer](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/youtube-summarizer.html) (added 2026-11-09): YouTube Summarizer turns a public YouTube link into notes built from the video's captions, with key takeaways, connected ideas, a structured summary or a long-form article view, free and without an account.
- [Oh My Android](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/oh-my-android.html) (added 2026-11-09): Oh My Android is a free, open-source (MIT) macOS control panel for the Android Emulator that toggles dark mode, font size, RTL, TalkBack, network speed and GPS in one click without adb, adds a Layout Inspector in dp and an accessibility audit, and ships an MCP server so AI agents can drive the emulator.
- [Zvec](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/zvec.html) (added 2026-11-09): Zvec is Alibaba's open-source, in-process vector database that embeds directly in your application for low-latency similarity search in RAG and agent memory, with HNSW, IVF and DiskANN indexes, quantisation, full-text search and builds for Linux, macOS, Windows, Android and iOS.
- [Claude Code Templates](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/claude-code-templates.html) (added 2026-11-09): Claude Code Templates is an open catalog and CLI of more than 1,980 Claude Code components (skills, subagents, slash commands, hooks, MCP servers and settings) at aitmpl.com, where you preview each file and combine components into one npx install that merges with your existing configuration.
- [Refly](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/refly.html) (added 2026-11-09): Refly is an open-source platform for building stable, versioned agent skills through a visual "vibe workflow": it compiles your team's SOPs into executable skills you can run in Refly, export to Claude Code or deploy as APIs and webhooks, with a community skill registry; self-host or use the cloud.
- [Ekko Studio](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ekko-studio.html) (added 2026-11-09): Ekko Studio (formerly Hermes Studio / Hermes Web UI) is a local-first desktop app and self-hosted web console for multi-agent chat, coding and visual workflows, supporting Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent and 14 coding-agent integrations including Claude Code and Codex, with group chat, voice, files and human approval gates.
- [Kortix CompanyOS](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kortix-companyos.html) (added 2026-11-09): Kortix CompanyOS is an open-source, cloud-native agent harness for companies: always-on agents start from schedules, webhooks, app events or team messages, run in parallel swarms on their own persistent cloud computers with shared company memory, connect to 3,000+ apps and land changes through team-approved reviews.
- [Archify](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/archify.html) (added 2026-11-09): Archify is an Apache-2.0 agent skill for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode that turns an idea, plan or whole codebase into an interactive HTML diagram you can explore, follow source links through and share, from repository maps to learning paths and travel plans.
- [Impeccable](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/impeccable.html) (added 2026-11-09): Impeccable gives coding agents a design vocabulary: install it into a project and steer with commands such as polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, and catch typical AI-generated design clichés before they ship; works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Copilot, Gemini CLI and more.
- [Taste Skill](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/taste-skill.html) (added 2026-11-09): Taste Skill is an MIT Agent Skill that pushes coding agents to build polished company websites instead of generic landing pages, enforcing one design system, plain copy, real photos and brand icons, restrained motion, and a browser-based checker and finish gate that verify the rules before a page is done.
- [Agent Skills (Addy Osmani)](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agent-skills-addy-osmani.html) (added 2026-11-09): Agent Skills by Addy Osmani packages senior-engineer workflows and quality gates as skills for AI coding agents, with nine slash commands such as /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review and /ship that walk an agent from idea to production with tests and review at each step.
- [Caveman](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/caveman.html) (added 2026-11-09): Caveman is an Apache-2.0 skill and proxy for coding agents that cuts tokens by making the agent answer in clipped "caveman" prose and read less context, while keeping code exact; it reports about a third fewer input tokens in Claude Code sessions and offers an Auto mode and a hosted Caveman Cloud.
- [UI UX Pro Max](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ui-ux-pro-max.html) (added 2026-11-09): UI UX Pro Max is an open-source agent skill that gives coding agents design intelligence for web and mobile UI, with a design-system generator that reasons over your product type and outputs matching styles, colour palettes, font pairings, layout patterns and UX rules for many frameworks.
- [Ponytail](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ponytail.html) (added 2026-11-09): Ponytail is an MIT-licensed skill for Claude Code and other coding agents that makes them write like a terse senior engineer: only the code a task needs, without cutting validation, error handling, security or accessibility; its published benchmark on 39 tasks reports roughly half the code, time and tokens while more risky logic ships with tests.

## Launches, status, and the Directory Launch Pack

- [How AgentScout started](https://agentscouthq.com/how-it-started.html): founder-run, mostly automated with AI agents. @clampdown19 (m lk) makes the calls.
- [Weekly launch board](https://agentscouthq.com/launches/): tools added each ISO week (Pacific), with server-side upvotes.
- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): up, down, and not-yet-checked counts. Updated daily, around 7 AM PT.
- [Directory Launch Pack](https://agentscouthq.com/submit.html#launch-pack): $49 one-time add-on, separate from the four listing tiers ($0 / $15 / $49 / $99/wk). Submitted to ~25 curated AI directories within 7 days, with a report of live and pending links, plus a follow-up report at 30 days (some directories take weeks to approve). Listings use your own email so you own every account. A few directories (e.g. ones that use GitHub or Google sign-in) may need you to click a quick sign-in yourself. If your tool is already listed in one of those directories, we skip it and submit to another from the same curated list. This is a separate add-on, not one of the four listing tiers ($0 / $15 / $49 / $99/wk). It does not change your rank on AgentScout and does not include Google indexing. Checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/28EfZidhp6lp9l3aDFe7m0f
- Fast-Track ($15) includes: Same-day indexing ping to Bing and IndexNow search engines (does not include Google).

## Community Grok Bot templates

- [PR Reviewer](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-pr-reviewer): Reviews pull requests for risk, missing tests, and thin context so review starts with the scary diff. Leads with what can break, what is untested.
- [Agent Looper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-agent-looper): You say what to build and how to know it's done. It keeps a coding agent working on your computer until that check passes.
- [Examiner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-examiner): Maintain a reliable timeline of important changes so you can reconstruct what happened when something later goes wrong. Isolated: talk only to you.
- [AI Harness Assistant](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-harness-assistant): Keeps the AI coding tools you already have, like Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Cursor, current on your Windows, Mac, and Linux machines.
- [GreenBuild](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-greenbuild): A senior QA and test-automation lead for testers and dev teams. It turns requirements into test plans and triages flaky tests.
- [UI/UX/Designer. Product Engineer 1000x](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-1000x-product-engineer): World-class product engineer for mobile and desktop web. Ships Convex + TanStack + React end to end. Simple, intuitive UI with real taste.
- [illo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-illo): Editorial illustration bot that uses the illo skill (tmchow/illo-skill) to turn ideas, posts, and announcements into mascot-led images on Grok Bot.
- [Design Expert](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-design-expert): A product design lead that keeps AI-built UIs honest.
- [Fabrication](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-fabrication): Takes your parts from CAD design to a finished 3D print. It checks fit, flat bed faces and hole sizes, and shows previews.
- [Churn retention manager](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-churn-retention-manager): Catches churn before it lands, offers a real alternative, and reports why people left. For businesses saving cancellations and failed payments.
- [Echo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-echo): Turns a customer call into slides from customer context. What we heard, next steps, project initiatives, or all of the above.
- [Events](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-events): A market and pop-up inventory desk for small sellers. It builds pack lists before a show and logs what sold afterward.
- [Go Direct](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-go-direct): Skip the press. Lulu helps founders tell their story straight to the 50 to 500 people who actually matter: investors, early customers, future hires.
- [LinkedIn Desk](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-linkedin-desk): LinkedIn Desk helps you keep network quality high without living in LinkedIn, by reviewing connection requests and LinkedIn invitations.
- [Meeting to Money](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-sumosign): Turns a sales meeting into a priced proposal, a signed go-ahead, an invoice, and payment chase. You approve every send. For freelancers and small agencies.
- [DOGE (Department of Grok Efficiency)](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-chief-of-staff-avid): A Grok Bot whose only job is to audit your other bots and routines, flag what to cut or merge, and find bottlenecks.
- [Watchdog](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-watchdog): On first install, scans email once as soon as Gmail is ready, then weekly for receipts, renewals, and trials.
- [AIUsageBot](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-usage-meter): Interviews you about which AI subscriptions to track and where leftover lives (local CLIs, apps), then pings remaining % as it drops.
- [SlowBooks Cutover](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-slowbooks-cutover): Migrate one QuickBooks Desktop company into SlowBooks via Conductor (read-only), then prove Trial Balance and spot-check P&L.
- [Newsletter Cleanup](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-newsletter-cleanup): Audits Gmail newsletters (last 6 months), builds a three-bucket review.html, then unsubscribes only what you approve. Never deletes mail.
